source.analysis_isolation: analysis/skeleton-project copied from analysis/unpacked-project; shared projects not mutated

archive.layout: SKYF u16 version1; recursive directory{name64,u16 child_count,u16 file_count,files{name128,u32 offset,u32 size},children}
archive.chunk_record: tag4,u32 id,u32 stored_bytes,u32 decoded_bytes,u32 compressed,u32 offset,u32 stale_pointer,u32 stale_pointer
archive.codec_selector: ADF root u32 at offset12 equals255 for zlib; otherwise original adaptive arithmetic decoder 0x0040fcc0

arithmetic.update_rule: swap decoded symbol with the first entry in its equal-frequency run; increment frequency and previous cumulative counts
arithmetic.bounded_finish: emit final required output symbol and finish before unnecessary next-state renormalization; finite original streams need not contain those subsequent bits

bone.root_rule: Parent resolution happens before inserting the bone. Missing parent, including self-parent root, falls back to owner mesh; runtime root marker clears the owner's skinned vertex accumulator.
bone.warnings: Other serialized pointer-looking fields are stale process addresses, not portable references. Bone IDs are u32 identities, not dense indices.

wmap.duplicate_chunk_rule: Last wmap chunk for a given bone replaces previous chunks, matching writes to bone+0x2e0 and bone+0x2e4; do not append maps.
wmap.inverse_bind_matrix: Not required: per-influence rest points are already in bone-local space.
wmap.weight_normalization: None: original runtime accumulates the supplied weights without division by their sum.
wmap.skinned_instance_transform: Identity when storing recovered world-space vertices, to avoid double application of owner transform.
wmap.normal_note: Original 0x00476eb0 branch clears position and normal buffers but accumulates only position. Replacement renderer intentionally accumulates weighted rotated supplied normals and normalizes the result for valid shading.

qkey.time_evidence: 0x0045c9e0 accumulates unsigned millisecond tick difference multiplied by float at0x0058d7c4=0.001; update threshold at0x00592018=33milliseconds.
qkey.translation_interpolation: Linear between adjacent key times; single-key tracks are constant.
qkey.rotation_interpolation: Shortest-arc Slerp on raw four-component quaternions; negate second contribution when dot<0; linear branch when1-abs(dot)<1e-6 (0x00592ef8).
qkey.matrix_quaternion: For standard column-major quaternion-to-matrix formula, map raw(qx,qy,qz,qw) to effective(qx,-qz,-qy,qw). Raw xyzw must not be used unchanged.
qkey.hierarchy: Original row-vector D3DX local*parentWorld (0x004769c0); equivalent column-major parentWorld*local in replacement.

mver.evidence: analysis/skeleton-return-game/decompile/00476190.c; original instructions0x00476240..0x00476265 use movss/mulss for FLOAT positions despite decompiler uint casts

ptri.winding: Runtime index output is source index2,index1,index0.
ptri.color_expansion: Each four-bit channel shifted to high nibble of its corresponding eight-bit output channel; exact original does not replicate low nibble.

implementation.check_to_run_by_integrator: Build scene target, invoke scene_decoder_self_test including scene_animation_self_test; optionally run tools/asset_skeleton.py original/app/base/objects.dat --output analysis/skeleton-corpus.json.
